svg.text: How marketing, creative and brand teams collaborate through the platform
PREPARED FOUNDATION Product facts • Original images • Approved claims • Brand rules • Scoped product / store analytics
Confirm current access and permitted use
Choose or upload a suitable pack shot
Review requested claims and source support
Approve exact wording and usage scope
If needed: resolve evidence, then recheck readiness
Retrieve eligible facts, images and metrics
Rerank and bind evidence to the brief
Generate concepts, copy and visual drafts
Select a direction and request edits
Adjust copy, layout and channel variants
Check claims, product fidelity and safety
Check brand rules, text and format
Save results against this artifact version
Approve permitted use or request changes
Record reviewer, scope and exact version
Pass, issue or missing evidence per check
Reasons for any hold or required action
Business metrics retain their time window
Correct layout, copy or product depiction
Confirm final design and channel variants
Sign-off attaches to the exact version
Return campaign IDs and real outcomes
Show preview, files and evidence pack
Use feedback and outcomes in evaluation
Create a new version for further edits
Only after required checks and approvals
Solid arrows: primary interaction and hand-off Dashed arrows: clarification, correction or feedback
Approved creative + copy + format variants + source evidence + analytics context + validation results + versioned sign-offs
The team works in chat and review screens; background preparation, retrieval, job recovery and record keeping remain platform responsibilities.
